body: Commit 866dbfa, pushed to origin/main as e291f16..866dbfa. Root cause: regen math truncated to 0 every tick at the real 16ms production tick rate, only ever worked in tests using large dt_ms=1000 steps. Fixed with a persistent fractional accumulator. 3 new tests, full suite 465 checks green.
title: Mana always trickles 1/sec even in combat, plus fixed a real latent bug where mana regen had never actually worked in production gameplay
